roomId.description: Target room id, required for brief-refresh and material-analysis.

roomTitle.description: Optional room title for context framing.

documentName.description: Name of the document being edited, for selection-rewrite provenance.

currentBrief.description: Current room brief for brief-refresh; user-edited fields are authoritative.

selectedText.description: The selected fragment to rewrite, required for selection-rewrite.

contextBefore.description: Document text before the selection, style context only.

contextAfter.description: Document text after the selection, style context only.

instruction.description: Rewrite instruction for selection-rewrite, or analysis focus for material-analysis.

blockType.description: Markdown block type of the selection, e.g. heading, bulletList, codeBlock.

formatContext.description: Editor format context of the selection (marks, list nesting, code language).

responseLanguage.description: BCP-47 language tag for natural-language output.
